verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the core CI-friendly workflow: `tofu plan -out=FILE` saves a plan artifact that can later be executed via `tofu apply FILE`, enabling non-interactive plan/apply separation. However, there is no explicit documentation of approval-flag mechanics (e.g., -auto-approve), CI pipeline integration examples, or a documented approval gating workflow in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit -auto-approve/approval-flag documentation, CI/CD pipeline integration examples, independent hands-on corroboration of the non-interactive workflow.
